# FIRST (For Inspiration and Recognition of Science and Technology)

> FIRST is a premier youth robotics and STEM education organization offering tiered programs (FLL, FTC, FRC) for students K-12 to compete, learn, and innovate through hands-on robotics challenges.

FIRST operates three main robotics competition programs targeting different grade levels: FIRST LEGO League (K-8), FIRST Tech Challenge (7-12), and FIRST Robotics Competition (9-12). The organization provides comprehensive resources, local support networks, and annual seasonal challenges to inspire the next generation of scientists and engineers.

## Core Programs

- [FIRST | For Inspiration and Recognition of Science and Technology](https://www.firstinspires.org): FIRST homepage showcasing youth robotics programs and STEM education initiatives
- [FIRST LEGO League | STEM Program for Grades K-8](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/fll): FIRST LEGO League program overview for K-8 hands-on STEM learning and competition
- [FIRST Tech Challenge | STEM Robotics Program for Grades 7-12](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/ftc): FIRST Tech Challenge program overview for grades 7-12 robotics competition
- [FIRST Robotics Competition | STEM Program for Grades 9-12](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/frc): FIRST Robotics Competition program for grades 9-12 advanced robotics
- [How to Choose a FIRST Program](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/choose-a-program): Guide to selecting appropriate FIRST program for students and groups
- [FIRST Event Experience | FIRST](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/events): Overview of FIRST events showcasing student innovation and competition

## Getting Started Guides

- [How to Get Started with FIRST LEGO League](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/fll/get-started): Step-by-step guide to launching FIRST LEGO League teams and programs
- [How to Get Started with FIRST Tech Challenge](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/ftc/get-started): Guide to starting FIRST Tech Challenge teams and robotics programs
- [How to Get Started with FIRST Robotics Competition](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/frc/get-started): Steps to launch FIRST Robotics Competition teams and high school programs
- [Cost & Registration | FIRST](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/cost-and-registration): Program costs, registration fees, and pricing information for FIRST programs

## Seasonal Games & Resources

- [UNEARTHED Game & Season | FIRST LEGO League](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/fll/game-and-season): FLL UNEARTHED 2025-2026 season game details, challenges, and resources
- [DECODE Game & Season | FIRST Tech Challenge](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/ftc/game-and-season): FTC DECODE 2025-2026 season game specs, videos, and challenge resources
- [REBUILT Game & Season | FIRST Robotics Competition](https://www.firstinspires.org/programs/frc/game-and-season): FRC REBUILT 2026 season game details, specifications, and team resources
- [Resource Library | FIRST](https://www.firstinspires.org/resources/library): Comprehensive resource library for FLL, FTC, and FRC programs and materials

## Community & Support

- [Find Local Support | FIRST](https://www.firstinspires.org/find-local-support): Locate local FIRST Program Delivery Partners and community mentors for robotics support
- [FIRST Community Blog | FLL](https://community.firstinspires.org/topic/fll): FLL community blog featuring news, stories, and team resources
- [FIRST Community Blog | FTC](https://community.firstinspires.org/topic/ftc): FTC community blog with championship updates, awards, and team news
- [FIRST Community Blog | FRC](https://community.firstinspires.org/topic/frc): FRC community blog featuring competition news, awards, and safety updates
